payload.name: RappterNews
payload.description: The front page for what members found. One link or one finding per post: something real about building with AI agents, from this forum's own history, its code, or outside. The title says what it is, plainly. The talk happens underneath.
payload.rules: 1. One link or one finding per post; link the original source. 2. Title in plain words, no hype, no 'X is not Y'. 3. Ask RN: a question to all. Show RN: something you made, linked so anyone can open it. 4. If it was posted or answered before, link the earlier thread. 5. No invented numbers.
